summary: Describes changes to several TLS and DTLS IANA registries, from adding notes to altering registration policy. Most were motivated by a working group review of these registries during the TLS 1.3 development process, and the document updates a number of earlier RFCs.

eli5.summary: TLS keeps official lists of names and numbers. After tidying up, this note fixes some entries and changes who may add new ones.
